name: native-e2e-ci
body: Native e2e CI job: a GitHub Actions matrix with one GitHub-hosted native runner per supported target: darwin/arm64 on an Apple silicon runner (e.g. `macos-14` / `macos-latest`), windows/amd64 on `windows-latest`, and windows/arm64 on `windows-11-arm` only if that runner is available to the private repo (otherwise the target is omitted, with no self-hosted fallback). Each job runs against its target's built binary. Steps: in a clean temp dir, `eypres init`, then `eypres start --no-open` in the background in its own process group; parse the printed URL; poll until HTTP 200 with the two starter slides (timeout about 30s); fetch reveal.js and theme assets and confirm they are served locally from the binary; enforce offline operation by blocking or disabling outbound network for the process or asserting no outbound connections (the mechanism is chosen per OS); stop it with SIGTERM on macOS or CTRL_BREAK_EVENT to the process group on Windows, then assert exit code 0, port released and no leftover child processes. A forced kill is only a timeout fallback, and using it fails the job.
